title: Reframe the Client Registry definition around governed, uncertain identity
requirements:
- Describe records as possibly provisional, incomplete or at differing assurance levels, reconciled later
- State that financing systems resolve identity via the registry while enrolment/eligibility live elsewhere
- Define the 'canonical record' as a governed reference that keeps source provenance, match confidence and correction history
- Remove facility-attendance history from the Facility Registry; place it in encounter or LHR data
- State that identity and demographic data remain sensitive personal data even though no clinical data is held
- Define how consent records identify subjects, representatives and authority
- Explain overlap and differences between Client Registry, MPI and EMPI, and how persons' roles (e.g. carer) are represented
- Make shared identity patterns with the Workforce Registry explicit while keeping domain differences
